slides.label: The 12th house
slides.title:
Your rest
budget
slides.subtitle: What you give up so you can keep going

slides.label: Most people fear it
slides.title:
Loss, bills,
hospitals
body: The old texts give the 12th house two jobs: your expenses and your sleep
When you skip rest, you pay for it anyway

slides.label: In real life
slides.title: Where it shows up
items: Every short night costs you the next day
A life in a new city means missed family dinners
A weekend offline, a prayer hour, giving to a cause

slides.label: Sutra
slides.quote:
What you won't spend on rest,
you will spend on recovery

slides.label: A strong 12th house
slides.title: Good at letting go
items: Rest, travel, a whole life abroad
Healers and carers, people who give without being seen

slides.label: Practical remedy
slides.title: Book rest first
body: Open your bank app: the last three months
Circle what came from being tired: late takeout, cancelled plans, the clinic visit
Add it up, then book two hours of rest this week
